title: anamnesis-elenchus-analogue/v1
description: What Elenchus may read from the corpus: source-linked historical analogues and no verdict. An analogue is a place to start, not a conclusion. Elenchus still reproduces the present failure and still earns its own guard; nothing in this projection can supply either, and the absence is structural rather than a convention the reader is asked to remember.

release_id.description: The release these analogues were read from.

locator.description: Where in the source the analogue was read from.

remediations.description: The remediation records this finding names, with the state the source recorded. Never a verification state.

adjudication.description: What the source said about the finding itself.

verdict.description: Always null. The projection has no field a verdict could occupy, so a past guarded result cannot travel through it into a present case.

not_established.description: Stated in the projection rather than left to the reader.
